en: A black‑and‑white landscape view of a European spa town nestled in a wooded valley. Grand late‑19th‑century hotel and spa buildings with domes, towers, and ornate façades rise above dense trees. The town climbs the hillside with multiple large resort complexes and villas in a forested setting; a couple of tall chimneys are visible among the roofs. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
